Tech Jobs Through Time

How tech jobs emerged, changed and disappeared, from the human computers of the 1940s to the AI engineers of 2026: periods, role lanes, pay in real dollars, demand, layoffs, H-1B and India's workforce. US data is the backbone, with an India and global thread. Parts are published newest first.

🗓️ The periods

Tap a period. Highlighted periods have a published article; the rest are coming.

🧑‍💻 Job lanes: born, peaked, faded

Years run left to right along the top; each lane is a job family. Each wave is one role: it swells as the role grows, peaks (○) and thins out as it fades. Colour = today's state; dashed arrows = one role turning into another; dashed outlines = approximate dates (our reading). On phones, swipe sideways.

Tap a role for its story and source.

📈 The numbers

⚠️ = secondary source; est. = our estimate or arithmetic. Real dollars use US CPI-U annual averages. Data: data/tech-jobs-history.json. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic, helps write this site.
